duration.description: Seconds to wait. Must be > 0 and at most 300.

idle_timeout.description: Seconds of output silence before reason 'idle'. Default 20, max 300. Only applies to exec tasks with mode=idle; ignored in completion mode.

mode.description: completion (default) waits for a terminal state or attention, regardless of output silence. idle observes output silence for servers/watchers that do not exit.

timeout.description: Max seconds for this wait. Default 120, max 600. On reason 'timeout', wait again for the same task. This does not cancel the task or extend its execution deadline.
